data.name: Bootstrap
data.subtitle: RootHide bootstrap for iOS 15 – 17
data.localizedDescription: Bootstrap is roothide's semi-jailbreak bootstrap for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 17.0 on A8 to A17 Pro and M1/M2 devices. Instead of jailbreaking the whole system it builds a hidden environment that boots Sileo, Zebra and rootless tweaks while App Store apps stay untouched — so banking, streaming and game apps that refuse to run on a jailbroken device keep working. Apps are patched one at a time when you want tweaks inside them, and the whole environment can be removed again.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned .tipa from roothide/Bootstrap, signed on install like any other sideloaded app. Supports iOS/iPadOS 15.0 – 17.0; requires the Kernel File Descriptor (kfd) exploit support present in the upstream build for your device. Do not combine with a full jailbreak on the same device. Upstream only publishes the TrollStore-named .tipa (the same container as an .ipa); clients that insist on the .ipa extension can rename the downloaded file before installing.
